sloka: हन्त पश्यस्व लङ्कायां वनान्युपवनानि च ।सेतुना सुखमागम्य वानरैकार्णवीकृतम् ।। ६.६२.१५ ।।
transliteration: hanta paśyasva laṅkāyāṁ vanānyupavanāni ca ।setunā sukhamāgamya vānaraikārṇavīkṛtam ।। 6.62.15 ।।

translations.english: " Alas! You see how the Vanaras, arriving at Lanka, crossing the bridge have done away with groves and gardens."
